title: Cataract Surgery in Pseudoexfoliation Syndrome Using the Eight-Chop Technique

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: 'Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) license', link https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

indication: Age-related cataract (Emery nucleus grade II-III), 150 eyes of 150 patients with or without pseudoexfoliation (PEX) syndrome diagnosed at the slit lamp; 21 of 75 PEX eyes had glaucoma; corneal disease or opacity, uveitis, diabetic retinopathy, white cataract, preoperative CECD < 2000 cells/mm2 and prior ocular trauma or surgery excluded

groups.description: PEX group: phacoemulsification with the eight-chop technique (eight-chopper I or II, Centurion system, 3.0 mm temporal clear corneal incision, sodium hyaluronate, in-the-bag Acrysof MN60AC IOL, intracameral moxifloxacin) by one surgeon experienced in the technique, Sato Eye Clinic, November 2014 to July 2024; iris hooks in 12 eyes for poor dilation, zonular weakness in 13 eyes without capsular tension ring
Control group (the authors' label): patients without PEX operated with the same eight-chop technique, surgeon and system; 75 operated eyes

exclusions.what: jpm-15-00396-t003 CV and PHC rows; Tables 1, 2, 4 and 5 (operative parameters, CECD, IOP, BCVA)

exclusions.reason: Other studies' aggregates without CCT; not this study's groups

exclusions.what: Postoperative day 1 and 2, week 1 and week 3 visits (Methods 2.7)
exclusions.reason: No CCT reported for these visits

notes: Both groups underwent the same standard technique of this surgeon (eight-chop); PEX syndrome defines a patient-condition subgroup, so both groups are control role. The authors' 'Control Group' is an operated non-PEX group, not unoperated eyes.

PEX-group n differs between outcome tables (Table 1: 75 eyes operated; CECD table n = 59; IOP table n = 69; CCT and BCVA tables n = 54) without a stated reason; the CCT series uses the Table 3 n = 54. Whether the 54 eyes were chosen by data availability or another criterion is not stated.
Preoperative pupil size and intraoperative parameters are reported per group in Table 1; iris hooks were used in 12 PEX eyes.
